info.title: OrenjiTrade API
info.description: REST API of OrenjiTrade, the geographic discovery network for trading cards. Generated from the Spring Boot application by `./gradlew exportOpenApi` (apps/api). Do not edit by hand.

get.description: Defaults favour safety: not discoverable, online status hidden, profile visible to members, messages from members with a profile, wishlist hidden.

put.description: Full replacement (every field required). Switching `discoverable` on derives the public map point from the trading area; switching it off removes the collector from the map immediately.

get.description: Defaults: push and in-app on, email off, MARKETING fully off.

put.description: Full replacement. Unknown categories, malformed times (HH:mm) and unknown time zones are 400.

get.description: Returns defaults derived from the account (handle, display name) until the profile is saved for the first time.

put.description: Full replacement of handle, display name, bio, games and languages. 400 for unknown games (yugioh, pokemon, mtg, riftbound), non ISO 639-1 languages or blocked terms; 409 HANDLE_TAKEN when the handle is used (case-insensitive) or reserved. The first save completes the `profileComplete` onboarding step.

At most 12 tags in total. `tagIds` must be active tags; `customLabels` (2-24 characters) are checked against the banned-term rules and created as CUSTOM tags (or matched to an existing tag with the same slug). Returns the resulting tags.
Radius 1-50 km, latitude within +/-85. The server snaps the centre to a ~1 km grid cell and offsets it with a deterministic per-user jitter to derive `publicPoint` (3 decimals) and its region label.

The listed binders come first in the given order; the others keep their relative order after them. 400 for duplicates, 404 when an id is not one of the caller's binders. Returns every binder in the new order.

put.summary: Replace the roles of an account (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
put.description: USER is always kept. Only a SUPER_ADMIN may grant or revoke ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, and nobody can remove their own SUPER_ADMIN. Audited.
Live edit: every instance applies the new value at once (cache evicted); counters keep their usage. Audited (`usage_limit.update`).
Name, description, display price, active flag, order and feature switches (listed features are upserted). FREE cannot be disabled. Audited (`plan.update`).

put.summary: Change a game and its schema (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
put.description: Name, publisher, status (HIDDEN removes it from public endpoints and profile choices), order and GameSchema. The slug is immutable. Audited (`game.update`).
Flags are created by migrations; unknown keys are 404. Takes effect on every instance at once (cache evicted). Audited (`feature_flag.update`).

400 unless 1 <= agingAfterDays < staleAfterDays < hiddenAfterDays <= 3650 and 0 <= warnBeforeHiddenDays < hiddenAfterDays. Takes effect on every instance at once (cache evicted) and on the next freshness job run. Audited (`delist_policy.update`).
Name, types, text and metadata; the slug is kept. Audited (`card.update`).

post.summary: Re-run wishlist matching for the last 24 h (service auth)
post.description: Nightly safety net: inventory items published in the last 24 hours are matched again (matches and notifications are idempotent, so only publications whose event was lost produce new ones) and wishlist items edited in that window are re-matched. Records a job run.
Every 15 minutes. Deletes image uploads older than 1 h that no message consumed, with their stored objects. Records a job run.
Records a `ping` job run and answers `{ "ok": true }`.

Hourly. Expired temporary publications become PRIVATE; freshness states of items and binders are re-derived from confirmedAt and the active delist policy; public listings entering the warning window are warned once; hidden listings stop being public (InventoryItemUnpublished). Never deletes. Records a job run.

post.summary: Pause listings of unresponsive owners (service auth)
post.description: Daily. Pauses the public listings of owners whose unresponsiveness strikes reached the policy's maxStrikes. Strike tracking arrives with Phases 5/7: until then the run is recorded and nobody is paused. Never deletes.
Anonymises every account whose grace period is over, purges module data, deletes the identity-provider user and records a job run. Consents, audit entries and ledgers are kept.

post.summary: Add a card to the wishlist
post.description: cardId (any printing) or printingId is required. The new item is matched at once against the public inventory nearby (no notification; see matchCount and GET /wishlist/{id}/matches); later publications notify (WISHLIST_MATCH). 409 CONFLICT for an identical wish; 429 LIMIT_REACHED beyond wishlist.items.max (FREE 20, PREMIUM 500) or a radius beyond map.radius.max_km.

409.description: CONFLICT: the same card with the same filters is already wished

post.description: Idempotent; a dismissed match never comes back for this wishlist item.

404.description: Unknown match or not the caller's

post.description: Idempotent. Optional JSON body `{reason}` (private note). 400 for oneself, 404 for unknown or deleted accounts.

404.description: Unknown collector

delete.description: Idempotent (204 whether or not a block existed).

post.summary: Upload an image for a message
post.description: Multipart part `file` (JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB; type sniffed from the content) and form field `kind` (MESSAGE, the default; INVENTORY is refused: inventory photos use POST /inventory/items/{id}/images). Re-encoded as JPEG (≤ 1600 px, EXIF/GPS stripped) and inspected before storage. Attach it with an IMAGE message within 1 h (`expiresAt`); unattached uploads are deleted. 413 above 8 MB, 415 for other types, 400 for unreadable images. Rate-limited (30 per hour).
Idempotent: the first read time is kept.

404.description: Unknown notification or not the caller's

200.description: How many notifications were marked read

post.description: Idempotent. A token registered by another account moves to the caller; an invalidated token becomes valid again.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (unknown platform, empty or malformed token)

post.description: Multipart part `file`: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB (type sniffed from the content). The server cover-crops it to a 512x512 square and re-encodes it without any metadata (EXIF/GPS stripped). 413 above 5 MB, 415 for other types, 400 for unreadable images. Rate-limited (10 per hour).

get.description: Newest first; lets clients find the pending request to cancel it after a reload.

post.summary: Request the deletion of the caller's account
post.description: Needs an ID token whose `auth_time` is at most 5 minutes old (401 REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED otherwise). On success the account becomes DELETION_REQUESTED, every identity-provider session is revoked (signed out everywhere; signing in again only gives access to GET /me, GET /me/export and these deletion endpoints), the collector disappears from the map and the deletion runs after a 7-day grace period. 409 DELETION_BLOCKED (extension `blockers[]`) while obligations are open; 409 CONFLICT when a request is already pending.
Stores the version, timestamp, a salted hash of the client IP and the user agent. 409 when the version is not the current one.

get.description: `query` matches card names (accent-insensitive, full text), printing codes (prefix) and set codes/names. `binderId` limits to one binder, `unfiled=true` to items without a binder. `sort`: updated (default, newest first), name (A-Z) or price (highest first); `direction` overrides the order.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Card name, printing code or set

schema.description: PRIVATE, PUBLIC or TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC (until publicUntil, at most 30 days ahead)
ACTIVE (recently confirmed), AGING, STALE (still public), HIDDEN (not public until confirmed)

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: asc | desc (default: desc for updated and price, asc for name)

post.description: Language, edition and finish default to the printing's; condition to NEAR_MINT (must be one of the game's conditions); currency to CAD. Visibility defaults to PUBLIC inside a binder (the binder decides whether it shows) and PRIVATE otherwise; TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC needs `publicUntil` at most 30 days ahead.

404.description: binderId is not one of the caller's binders

post.summary: Add a photo to an item
post.description: Multipart part `file`: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB (type sniffed from the content). Re-encoded as JPEG, at most 1600 px on the long side, without any metadata (EXIF/GPS stripped). At most 4 photos per item (409). 413 above 8 MB, 415 for other types, 400 for unreadable images. Rate-limited (60 per hour).

409.description: CONFLICT: the item already has 4 photos

post.summary: Confirm an item is still available
post.description: Refreshes `confirmedAt` (and the binder's): freshness back to ACTIVE, a HIDDEN item becomes public again when its visibility allows it.

404.description: Unknown, deleted or not the caller's item

post.summary: Bulk operation on the caller's items
post.description: One transaction. SET_VISIBILITY (`visibility`, `publicUntil` for TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC), MOVE_TO_BINDER (`binderId`; null = unfiled), SET_AVAILABILITY (`availability`), CONFIRM, DELETE. Items that are not the caller's (or unknown/deleted) are skipped as NOT_FOUND, items already in the requested state as UNCHANGED. 404 when `binderId` is not one of the caller's binders.

get.description: Most recent activity first, cursor-paginated. Conversations hidden by a block in either direction are omitted, as are empty conversations started by the other participant. `archived=true` lists the archive instead of the inbox. `other.onlineStatus` is HIDDEN unless the participant shows their online status.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

post.summary: Start (or reopen) a conversation with a collector
post.description: Idempotent: returns the existing conversation of the pair (200) or creates it (201); never 409. 403 MESSAGING_BLOCKED when a block exists in either direction or, for a new conversation, when the recipient's messaging permission refuses the caller (NOBODY, or MEMBERS_WITH_PROFILE and the caller has no saved profile). 404 for unknown, suspended or deleted recipients; 400 for oneself.

404.description: Unknown recipient

post.summary: Mark a conversation read up to a message
post.description: Moves the caller's read marker forward (never backward) and pushes a read receipt to both participants on /user/queue/receipts. 400 when the message is not part of the conversation.

404.description: Unknown conversation (or not a participant, or hidden by a block)

get.description: Cursor-paginated, newest first. `readByOther` tells whether the participant who did not send a message has read it. REMOVED messages keep their place with an empty body and payload.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

404.description: Unknown conversation (or not a participant, or hidden by a block)

post.description: TEXT needs `body` (≤ 4000 characters); CARD_LINK `cardPrintingId`; BINDER_LINK `binderId` of a public binder; IMAGE `imageUploadId` of POST /uploads/images (within 1 h). OFFER_LINK and SYSTEM are refused (400). Moderation: 422 MESSAGE_BLOCKED for content the rules refuse (generic reason), FLAG rules store the message as FLAGGED; 429 RATE_LIMITED above the rate rule (30 per minute). 403 MESSAGING_BLOCKED when a block exists or the other participant cannot receive messages. Pushed to both participants on /user/queue/messages.

404.description: Unknown conversation (or not a participant)

get.description: Cursor-paginated, chronological.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

post.description: `body` 1-1000 characters. Moderation as for posts (422 POST_BLOCKED, 429 RATE_LIMITED).

get.description: Cursor-paginated. Posts of collectors blocked in either direction, of suspended or deleted accounts, deleted and removed posts are not served. 404 for unknown or archived channels.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

404.description: Unknown channel or FEATURE_DISABLED

post.description: `body` 1-2000 characters, optional `cardPrintingId` and public `binderId` links. 409 DUPLICATE_POST when the caller posted the same text in the last 24 hours; 429 RATE_LIMITED above the channel's postRateLimitPerHour (default 10) or the moderation rate rule; 422 POST_BLOCKED for text the moderation rules refuse (FLAG rules store the post as FLAGGED for review).

get.description: In the caller's order (see PUT /binders/reorder).

post.description: Added at the end of the caller's list. PRIVATE unless `visibility` says otherwise; TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC needs `publicUntil` at most 30 days ahead. 429 LIMIT_REACHED (limitKey `binders.max`) beyond the plan's binder limit.
Its items keep their own visibility.

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

post.description: PUBLIC / UNTIL_DISABLED: public without an end date; ONE_HOUR / ONE_DAY: TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC until now + 1 h / 24 h. Publishing confirms the binder and its items (hidden stale items come back). Items still need their own visibility PUBLIC (the default inside a binder) to show.

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

post.summary: Confirm a binder is still available
post.description: Refreshes the confirmation of the binder and every item in it: freshness back to ACTIVE, HIDDEN listings restored.

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

post.description: 409 when the account is not suspended. Audited.
Blocks every API call of the account (403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED) and disables the identity-provider user. Audited.

get.description: Active, expired and revoked entitlements, newest first.

post.description: Overrides a plan limit (`value` = number or `unlimited`) or feature (`true` / `false`) for one account, optionally until `expiresAt`. Takes effect at once. Audited (`entitlement.grant`).
409 when the code exists for the game. Audited (`card_set.create`).
Closes an open flag with an optional note. 409 when already resolved. Audited (`moderation.flag.resolve`).

404.description: Unknown flag

get.summary: List games including hidden ones (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)

post.description: 409 when the slug exists. Audited (`game.create`).
Audited with the reason (`community.reply.remove`).
The post disappears for everybody (moderation state REMOVED); its open moderation flags are resolved. Audited with the reason (`community.post.remove`). 409 when already removed.

404.description: Unknown post

get.description: Archived channels included.

post.description: 409 when the slug exists; 400 for an unknown game. Audited (`community.channel.create`).
Returns the QUEUED run at once; the import runs asynchronously and is idempotent (unchanged rows are not rewritten). Poll `GET /admin/catalog/sync-runs/{id}`. Audited (`catalog.sync.request`).
The slug is derived from the name (suffixed when taken) and never changes. Metadata of declared GameSchema fields must have the declared type. Audited (`card.create`).

post.summary: Add a printing to a card (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
post.description: Set of the same game; edition, language, finish and rarity from the GameSchema; 409 for a duplicate (set, number, edition, language, finish). Audited (`card_printing.create`).

delete.description: Its matches are removed with it.

404.description: Unknown item or not the caller's

patch.summary: Update a wishlist item (any subset of the fields)
patch.description: Absent fields are unchanged. Changing the criteria re-matches the item (dismissed matches stay dismissed).

404.description: Unknown item or not the caller's
Unknown, deleted or not the caller's item

delete.description: Soft delete: the item disappears everywhere; its photos are removed.

404.description: Unknown, deleted or not the caller's item

patch.summary: Update an item (any subset of the fields)
patch.description: Absent fields are unchanged. `askingPrice`, `publicUntil`, `binderId`, `notes` and `publicNotes` may be null to clear them. TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC needs `publicUntil` at most 30 days ahead. Making the item public confirms it.

404.description: Unknown, deleted or not the caller's item (or binder)

patch.summary: Mute or archive a conversation (caller only)
patch.description: Absent fields are kept. A new message un-archives the conversation for both participants.

404.description: Unknown conversation (or not a participant, or hidden by a block)

delete.description: Soft delete; a moderator deleting another member's post is audited.

403.description: Neither the author nor a moderator

patch.description: Replaces the text (moderation applies; 422 POST_BLOCKED). 403 for other members.

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

delete.description: Its items become unfiled (they keep their visibility only when the binder was PUBLIC without an end date, otherwise they become PRIVATE), or are deleted with `deleteItems=true`.

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

patch.summary: Update a binder (any subset of the fields)
patch.description: Absent fields are unchanged; `publicUntil` and `coverPrintingId` may be null. Making the binder PUBLIC or TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC confirms it and its items (like publish).

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

patch.summary: Edit or archive a community channel (MODERATOR+)
patch.description: Absent fields are kept; `status: ARCHIVED` hides the channel from members. Audited (`community.channel.update`).

404.description: Unknown channel

get.summary: Public items matching a wishlist item (newest first)
get.description: Cursor-paginated. Each match carries the public item (never private notes), the owner's map marker at the derived public point and the distance bucket between the two collectors' public points. Items that stopped being public and collectors blocked in either direction are left out; dismissed matches only with includeDismissed=true.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

404.description: Unknown item or not the caller's

get.description: Active tags whose label or slug contains `query` (case and accent insensitive), prefix matches first, then the most used. Without `query`: the most used tags. Rate-limited (60 per minute).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Substring of the label or slug

get.description: Newest first. `query` matches the exact code first, then the name (full text, substring, trigram).

get.summary: Set with a page of its printings (public)
get.description: Printings by collector number; `page`/`size` page them.

Cards (full text + trigram), printings (printing-code prefix, or the printings of the resolved card), sets, collectors and public binders, at most `limit` per section (`types` narrows the sections). When `q` designates a printing (an exact code carried by one printing) or a card (an exact code of one card, an exact card name or a single card hit), `resolved` is set and `collectors` lists the holders of it with `matchingItems` (nearby when a centre is known: `lat`/`lng` or the signed-in caller's trading area); otherwise collectors matching the text. Binders carry their owner block. `radiusKm` beyond the plan cap → 429 LIMIT_REACHED. Emits the analytics events search_performed / search_no_results.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Sections: cards, printings, sets, collectors, binders (repeated or comma separated; default all)

400.description: Invalid query, type, game or centre

get.description: Printing codes and cards, collectors on the map who allow name search (closest first when `lat`/`lng` or the caller's trading area is known), sets, public binders and tags, interleaved one per kind until `limit`. COLLECTOR entries carry the handle in `slug`, TAG entries the tag slug, PRINTING entries their `cardId`.

get.summary: Collectors near you holding a card (auth optional)
get.description: Public, fresh (ACTIVE or AGING) items of `printingId` or of any printing of `cardId` (exactly one) held by collectors on the map within `radiusKm` of the centre (`lat`/`lng`, else the signed-in caller's trading area; required when signed out). The caller's own items are excluded. Filters: `availability`, `condition`, `minPrice`/`maxPrice` (items without a price never match), `freshness`, `edition`, `language`, `acceptsOffers`. `sort`: distance (default), price, freshness. Each row pairs the holder's marker with the public item.

schema.description: ACTIVE (recently confirmed), AGING, STALE (still public), HIDDEN (not public until confirmed)

get.description: `file` is `<card slug>.svg`. Generated on the server from the card name; no scripts or external references. Public cache for a day, ETag.
Serves an object of the media storage by key (for example `avatars/<user id>/<random>.jpg`). Immutable: cache for a year.

Map of flag key to effective value. Anonymous callers see flags rolled out to everybody; with a bearer token, partial rollouts are evaluated for the caller. Flags change live through the admin console.

404 unless the binder is public right now (visibility, expiry, freshness, the owner's account state and privacy settings). The owner block carries a region label and, for signed-in callers with a trading area, a distance bucket; never coordinates. Signed-in callers other than the owner consume `binder.views.per_day` once per binder and UTC day (429 LIMIT_REACHED beyond the plan limit).

404.description: Unknown or non-public binder

get.summary: Public items of a public binder (auth optional)
get.description: 404 unless the binder is public right now. Only items that are public right now, by card name. Never private notes or coordinates.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Card name, printing code or set

404.description: Unknown or non-public binder

get.summary: Printing with card, set, images and metadata (public)
Active plans with features and limits (public)
get.description: Ordered for display (FREE first). `limit` null means unlimited.
Cursor-paginated, newest first; `unreadOnly=true` lists unread ones only. Notifications whose in-app channel was disabled by the caller's preferences are never listed.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor of the previous slice

get.description: Provisions the account on the first call. Exempt from the terms-acceptance check so clients can discover `requiredConsents`.

get.summary: The caller's plan, limits with usage, features and entitlements
get.description: Limits carry the effective value (entitlements override the plan), the usage of the current window and when it resets (UTC day or month; null for totals and caps).
Cheapest authenticated call: refreshes the caller's last-active timestamp and is subject to the terms-acceptance check like every other route.

get.summary: The caller's trading area and public point
get.description: The only endpoint that returns the caller's chosen centre. `publicPoint` is what other collectors see and is null while not discoverable.

delete.description: Deletes every location row; the collector disappears from the map.

get.description: JSON document with one section per module (account + consents, profile + tags + privacy settings, notification preferences, trading area, ...). Served as an attachment. Rate-limited (10 per hour); also available while a deletion is pending.
Item and copy totals, items per visibility and game, freshness counts, items public right now and the next temporary publication end.
ACTIVE games in display order, each with its GameSchema.
404 for unknown or hidden games.
Active channels ordered for display. `game` filters by game slug, `region` by city (accent- and case-insensitive). 404 FEATURE_DISABLED while the publicChat flag is off.

404.description: FEATURE_DISABLED

get.description: Handle lookup is case-insensitive. 404 when the account does not exist, is suspended, pending deletion or deleted, or when the profile is PRIVATE (for everyone but its owner). `location` is null unless the collector is discoverable; `distanceBucket` needs a trading area on the caller's side and `showDistance` on the collector's. Coordinates are the derived public point only (3 decimals).

200.description: Public profile as seen by the caller

404.description: Unknown, hidden or private collector

get.description: Only when the collector shows their wishlist (privacy setting wishlistVisible) and their profile is visible to the caller: the active items as card, printing and minimum condition (never notes, prices or radii). 404 otherwise, and for unknown, suspended, deleted or blocked collectors.

404.description: Unknown collector or wishlist not visible

get.summary: Map preview card of a collector (auth optional)
get.description: The marker payload of one collector on the map plus `canMessage` and `isBlocked`. 404 unless the collector is on the map (unknown, suspended, pending deletion, not discoverable or PRIVATE profile). `distanceBucket` is measured from `lat`/`lng` when given, else from the signed-in caller's trading area; null for signed-out callers.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Centre latitude for the distance bucket

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Centre longitude for the distance bucket

404.description: Collector not on the map

get.summary: Public items of a collector across binders (auth optional)
get.description: Only items that are public right now, by card name. 404 when the collector is suspended, pending deletion, deleted, has a PRIVATE profile or a block exists. Never private notes or coordinates.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Card name, printing code or set

404.description: Unknown or hidden collector

get.summary: Public binders of a collector (auth optional)
get.description: Only binders that are public right now and hold at least one public item, in the owner's order. 404 when the collector is suspended, pending deletion, deleted, has a PRIVATE profile or a block exists. Empty when the collector is neither discoverable nor has a PUBLIC profile.

404.description: Unknown or hidden collector

get.summary: Collectors on the map around a centre (auth optional)
get.description: Discoverable collectors (ACTIVE account, profile not PRIVATE) whose derived public point is within `radiusKm` of the centre (`ST_DWithin` on the public point). The centre is `lat`/`lng` snapped to 0.01° or, when omitted, the signed-in caller's own trading area; signed-out callers must pass it. `radiusKm` defaults to 10 (lowered to the plan cap); beyond the caller's `map.radius.max_km` (FREE 25, PREMIUM 100; signed-out: FREE) → 429 LIMIT_REACHED. Filters: `game` (plays it or lists it), `availability` (TRADE, SALE, TRADE_OR_SALE, ACCEPTS_OFFERS), `freshness` (ACTIVE or AGING), `tags` (any), `hasPrintingId` / `hasCardId` (lists it publicly), `query` (handle, display name or tag text of collectors who allow name search). Collectors whose public listings are all stale never appear; STALE and HIDDEN items never match. Ranking: freshness (ACTIVE > AGING > no listings), distance, rating. Signed-out callers get no distance buckets. Cached 60 s per rounded centre, radius and filters.

parameters.name: radiusKm
parameters.description: Radius in km (default 10, capped by the plan)

schema.description: ACTIVE (recently confirmed), AGING, STALE (still public), HIDDEN (not public until confirmed)

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Tag slugs (any), repeated or comma separated

parameters.name: hasCardId
parameters.description: Collectors listing a printing of this card publicly

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Handle, display name or tag text

400.description: Invalid filter, partial centre, or no centre for a signed-out caller

get.description: Full-text search on name, type and text (accent-insensitive, `simple` config) ranked with ts_rank_cd, plus trigram typo tolerance when fewer than 5 rows match. An exact printing code (`AZR-EN001`) returns that card only. Filters: `game`, `set` (id or code), printing `rarity`, `language`, `edition`, and `metadata.<key>=<value>` for the game's filterable GameSchema fields (requires `game`; number, string, string_list and boolean fields; repeat a string_list key to require several values). Without `query`: by name. `metadata` in the results holds the game's summary fields.
404 for unknown cards and cards of hidden games.
Earliest set first; images default to the placeholder SVG.
Printing-code prefixes (`AZR-EN0`) first (kind PRINTING), then cards by name: prefix, substring, full text, trigram (kind CARD).

get.summary: Items of one of the caller's binders
get.description: Same filters and sort as GET /inventory/items. 404 when the binder is not the caller's (others use GET /public/binders/{id}/items).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Card name, printing code or set

schema.description: PRIVATE, PUBLIC or TEMPORARILY_PUBLIC (until publicUntil, at most 30 days ahead)
ACTIVE (recently confirmed), AGING, STALE (still public), HIDDEN (not public until confirmed)

404.description: Unknown binder or not the caller's

get.description: Newest first. `query` matches handle, email and display name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of handle, email or display name

get.description: Account, roles, consents, public location label (never coordinates), pending deletion request and recent audit entries.
Every limit of every plan (optionally one plan), by plan then key.

get.summary: List plans with features and limits (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN)
get.description: Active and inactive plans, by sort order.

Newest first. `state`: OPEN (default), RESOLVED or ALL. Flags are raised by FLAG banned-term rules, repeated-content thresholds (content) and rate thresholds (subjectType USER). No automatic ban ever follows a flag.
Every flag with its rollout, description and last editor, by key.
Freshness thresholds in days since the last owner confirmation.
